sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Gumball result/handles service; preview/cancel/commit thống nhất với SDK transform.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.

gumball_fast_exit_viewport_2026_11_03.scope: Preserve an eligible original viewport press when its initial movement exits the viewport before the next UI frame.
gumball_fast_exit_viewport_2026_11_03.limitations: Perspective Z fixture remains inside the application window; other handles, overlapping UI and post-fix desktop remain unverified.

one_frame_gumball_drag_2026_11_03.scope: Retain the still-valid published input basis for a primary gesture awaiting capture, including a tested one-frame Perspective drag after zoom.
one_frame_gumball_drag_2026_11_03.limitations: Synthetic in-viewport input only; fast viewport exit, all modes, physical presentation and post-fix desktop remain unverified.

batched_gumball_press_after_zoom_2026_11.scope: Commit a tested two-frame in-viewport Gumball drag when press and initial movement were batched after zoom and the published press basis remains valid.
batched_gumball_press_after_zoom_2026_11.limitations: All events in one frame, fast initial viewport exit, other handles and post-fix desktop remain unverified.

release_gumball_desktop_followup_2026_11.scope: Observe Perspective box Gumball, Undo and zoom in an isolated release window with synthetic Windows input.
release_gumball_desktop_followup_2026_11.limitations: First post-zoom drag showed no visible displacement and is inconclusive; no physical mouse, numeric placement, timing or real user model.

surface_exact_far_clip_2026_11_03.scope: Omit exact Surface hits outside the camera slab without discarding other valid candidates.
surface_exact_far_clip_2026_11_03.limitations: Real NURBS display fixture covers one orthographic and one Perspective ray; general boundaries, visibility, worker integration and desktop remain open.

nurbs_ray_miss_2026_11_03.scope: Skip an exact NURBS ray miss while retaining other source-validated Surface candidates and existing occlusion checks.
nurbs_ray_miss_2026_11_03.limitations: Fixture uses an altered candidate; actual tessellation coverage, general visibility and desktop remain open.

surface_fixed_group_results_2026_11_03.scope: Keep bounded Surface face-ray points and temporary candidate slots inline rather than allocating group-result vectors.
surface_fixed_group_results_2026_11_03.limitations: Other allocations and native peak remain unbudgeted; no new release peak or desktop measurement.

surface_group_copy_reduction_2026_11_03.scope: Use borrowed bounded groups and iterator selection to avoid two temporary candidate-copy arrays in UI/worker Surface paths.
surface_group_copy_reduction_2026_11_03.limitations: Remaining group/result/index allocations and native peak are not covered by production budget or release memory measurement.

surface_interleaved_face_groups_2026_11_.scope: Synchronous UI groups interleaved B-rep candidates by root/member path and restores original order before depth choice.
surface_interleaved_face_groups_2026_11_.limitations: Temporary grouping allocations lack production admission; performance after this change and desktop presentation remain unmeasured.

surface_ui_release_resolver_probe_2026_1.scope: Compare individual and grouped uncached synchronous UI face refinement in one release process on a generated 16-hole B-rep.
surface_ui_release_resolver_probe_2026_1.limitations: One fixture and baseline-first ordering; excludes candidate generation, shaded occlusion, full frame and desktop presentation.

surface_ui_grouped_face_refinement_2026_.scope: Line and Snappy Gumball use bounded grouped refinement for contiguous uncached same-source face candidates with source/view validation.
surface_ui_grouped_face_refinement_2026_.limitations: Still synchronous; release UI/desktop timing, background scheduler integration, native peak admission and full picking coverage are open.

surface_grouped_face_refinement_2026_11_.scope: Experimental worker groups at most eight matching B-rep face candidates into one call-local OCCT source reconstruction; cancellation checked between calls.
surface_grouped_face_refinement_2026_11_.limitations: Not wired to UI; native peak and extra group allocations lack production admission, broad geometry and desktop validation remain open.

surface_trimmed_memory_probe_2026_11_03.scope: Three isolated release Surface worker probes on a generated 16-hole, 22-face B-rep with independently checked front intersection.
surface_trimmed_memory_probe_2026_11_03.limitations: Process high-water deltas are not a native upper bound; fixture preparation, candidate generation and desktop latency are outside the measured worker interval.

surface_worker_memory_probe_2026_11_03.scope: Two isolated release process memory probes for experimental Surface worker, one and 50 overlapping sphere candidates.
surface_worker_memory_probe_2026_11_03.limitations: One run per synthetic fixture; process high-water difference is not a native upper bound or a production reservation policy.

surface_stl_concurrent_fixture_2026_11_0.scope: Exercise an experimental Surface worker and STL export from the same immutable sphere source, with analytic snap and encoded-vertex checks.
surface_stl_concurrent_fixture_2026_11_0.limitations: Actual native-call overlap is not instrumented; one fixture cannot prove OCCT thread safety, global STL error, native peak or desktop behavior.

surface_worker_storage_floor_2026_11_03.scope: Include retained candidate and instance-path capacity in the experimental Surface worker's minimum reservation check.
surface_worker_storage_floor_2026_11_03.limitations: Not a native peak, allocator or overall managed RAM bound; worker is not integrated into UI.

surface_worker_busy_retry_2026_11_03.scope: Experimental scheduler keeps the latest request while its shared Surface slot is busy and retries on polling; cancellation and stale selection release the reservation.
surface_worker_busy_retry_2026_11_03.limitations: No UI integration, fairness guarantee, native peak or desktop validation.

surface_worker_slot_2026_11_03.scope: Serialize experimental Surface workers within one shared coordinator account and preserve the slot across account adoption.
surface_worker_slot_2026_11_03.limitations: Independent accounts and other native operations remain concurrent; UI integration, native peak and desktop are open.

surface_worker_snapshot_identity_2026_11.scope: Bind experimental Surface worker receipts and scheduler requests to the captured document snapshot, including same-ID replacement rejection.
surface_worker_snapshot_identity_2026_11.limitations: Worker is not wired to UI; native memory sizing, concurrency and desktop remain unverified.

surface_cache_context_2026_11_03.scope: Revalidate cached Surface candidates and distinguish captured document allocations; focused stale-camera and replacement tests pass.
surface_cache_context_2026_11_03.limitations: Desktop behavior, asynchronous refinement and full candidate coverage remain open.

preview_two_view_pixels_2026_11_03.scope: Check Gumball preview pixel publication and unchanged document/Undo in two synthetic viewports.
preview_two_view_pixels_2026_11_03.limitations: Two sampled pixels per view with distinct synthetic cameras; physical input and desktop presentation remain open.

moving_selection_preview_receipts_2026_1.scope: Reject stale moving frame IDs after selection or preview changes without a document epoch change.
moving_selection_preview_receipts_2026_1.limitations: Pixel-level preview and physical input/presentation are not established by these synthetic GPU tests.

published_colour_isolation_2026_11_03.scope: Keep published viewport pixels stable during tested stationary mode updates, resizing and superseding camera changes.
published_colour_isolation_2026_11_03.limitations: Physical input, displayed presentation, moving-frame synchronization and broader picking correctness remain open.

off_axis_surface_clipping_2026_11_03.scope: Headless off-axis sphere Surface snap with near/far clipping in Perspective and orthographic views
off_axis_surface_clipping_2026_11_03.limitations: One analytic fixture; general boundary, silhouette and desktop verification remain open.

surface_triangle_scale_2026_11_03.scope: Scale-relative ray/triangle intersection for Surface candidates and visible mesh occlusion.
surface_triangle_scale_2026_11_03.limitations: Headless display-geometry fixtures only; numerical corner cases, kernel refinement at tiny scales and desktop remain open.

surface_triangle_seam_2026_11_03.scope: Avoid a reproduced missed Surface snap at a shared display-triangle edge and refine the tested point against the NURBS source.
surface_triangle_seam_2026_11_03.limitations: Empirical floating-point margin; general topology and desktop interaction remain unverified.

surface_candidate_broad_phase_2026_11_03.scope: Use the scene spatial index for tested Surface snap candidate enumeration and avoid dropping near-parallel rays.
surface_candidate_broad_phase_2026_11_03.limitations: Warmed-index synthetic timing only; index rebuild, complex geometry, allocation admission and desktop behavior remain open.

surface_snap_camera_clipping_2026_11_03.scope: Surface snap skips intersections before camera near plane in tested B-rep and NURBS cases.
surface_snap_camera_clipping_2026_11_03.limitations: Clipping boundaries, complex geometry, general selection and desktop verification remain open.

nurbs_surface_snap_2026_11_03.scope: Source-bound NURBS Surface snap refinement for Line and Snappy Gumball on tested fixtures.
nurbs_surface_snap_2026_11_03.limitations: Display-dependent candidate generation, complex surfaces, synchronous cost and desktop verification remain open.

hatch_surface_occlusion_2026_11_03.scope: Shaded Hatch display triangles block Line and Snappy Gumball Surface snaps behind them.
hatch_surface_occlusion_2026_11_03.limitations: Headless fixture; Hatch GPU pixels, general occlusion and desktop interaction remain unverified.

selection_latency_2026_11_02.scope: Reuse revalidated pick candidates and current-document validation proof; defer exact BRep info measurement from the click path.
selection_latency_2026_11_02.limitations: Single automated native-window click per build; GPU selection resources still rebuild and broader performance remains open.

runtime_implementation.scope: Matrix click/Shift/Ctrl selection, window/crossing marquee, type+layer-swatch popup, Gumball axis drag, alignment/relocate and numeric edit.
remaining: Manual M02-UI visual review of click mapping, marquee, popup, and Gumball drag/numeric feedback.
